JEE Advanced-Style Mock — AM Sir Set (9 Sep 26)

Built from your uploaded screenshot set — 28 questions pulled from a larger paper (originals numbered up to Q45).

  • 28 Questions, 145 minutes. A countdown timer runs top-right; the test auto-submits at zero.
  • Each question also tracks the time you spend on it individually — shown live and in your final report.
  • Three question types: Single-correct (choose one of A–D), Multi-correct (choose one or more of A–D — marked with an orange tag), and Numerical Value (type the number).
  • Marking: Single-correct & numerical: +4 correct, −1 incorrect, 0 unattempted. Multi-correct uses the standard JEE Advanced partial scheme: +4 if you select all correct options and nothing else, +1 per correct option if you select a correct subset with no wrong options, −2 if you select any incorrect option, 0 if unattempted.
  • Note: This set has no separate step-by-step solutions in the source — only a final answer key. The review screen shows the correct option(s)/value but not a worked solution.
  • Note: Questions 19 and 20 refer to a shared "nails and thread" setup whose descriptive paragraph/figure wasn't in the uploaded screenshots — you may be missing context for those two.
  • Use Save & Next, Mark for Review & Next, or Clear Response. The question palette on the right shows status of every question — click any number to jump to it.
